maya: Quick report - console permission preview showed ALLOW for svc:metrics-ingest on /v1/emit even though the live auth check returned DENY. Repro on staging with a per-route deny + recent quota-routing change.
jorge: Can you share the minimal steps and timestamps?
maya: Steps: create role `metrics-writer` granting `dataset:metrics`, add binding on tenant:acme-team, then add a per-route DENY for `/v1/emit` on that tenant. Preview response included `Policy-Stamp: ps-20260210-1532` generated_at 2026-02-10T15:32:05Z. Live auth returned `policy_rev: pr-20260210-1536`.
rachel: Looks like snapshot vs live divergence. We recently optimized incremental routing updates which might not land into the snapshot immediately. UX-wise we should surface the stamp and show a subtle stale warning when stamp != live rev.
maya: I sketched a small UX: show a mono label `Policy stamp: ps-...` and an orange dot if stamp age > 30s with tooltip "Snapshot may be stale vs live policy - click Compare". Then a CTA "Compare revisions" that calls a cheap compare API.
jorge: Backend plan: add `X-Policy-Stamp` and `X-Route-Fingerprint` headers on preview responses. Implement `GET /api/preview/compare?tenant={}` that returns one-line JSON with `snapshot_stamp`, `policy_rev`, `route_fingerprint`, and `consistent:true|false`. Keep it cheap: compare revision ids from redis index updated by reconcile leader. Avoid heavy reconcile in the hot path.
rachel: Also add `X-Preview-Trace-Id` header when we sampled a detailed explain. Store explains in redis with TTL 1h and only sample ~0.5% of previews to limit overhead. When user clicks "Show trace" the console fetches `/api/preview/trace/{id}`. Traces must redact principals - include only role_id, binding_id, scope, route_id, and the final decision line.
maya: For on-demand checks: expose a "Run live check" button that calls auth-service directly and shows the live decision below the preview. Important: throttle to 5/min/user and show cooldown.
jorge: Telemetry: increment `preview.compare.mismatch` when compare reports inconsistent; emit `preview.stamp_age_seconds` histogram. Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.4% / tenant over 1h.
rachel: Implementation notes: 1) reconcile leader will write current `policy_rev` and `route_fingerprint` to redis key `policy:index:{tenant}` on every successful apply. 2) preview service reads snapshot from object store but pulls the index keys for O(1) compare and headers. 3) trace explains are stored `preview:trace:{id}` in redis with TTL 3600s and redacted fields only.
perm-bot: Permission cache invalidated for tenant:acme-team at 1759810015 (auto).
maya: Assignments: jorge -> add headers + compare endpoint PR; rachel -> trace sampling + redis TTL + redact schema; maya -> UI changes (stamp, pill, compare button, run live check cooldown). Also add a quick smoke test toggling per-route deny and asserting mismatch appears then clears after reconcile.
jorge: I'll open the PR for headers + compare today. Keep `force_reconcile` disabled by default in UI; use compare first.
rachel: I'll add Grafana panel `preview.mismatch_rate` and a playbook line for paging.
maya: One more UX detail: when compare reports inconsistent, show an inline banner: "Preview may be stale. Click 'Compare' to see revision diff or 'Run live check' for current decision (rate-limited)." Keep banners compact.

maya: Thanks team — landing the header + pill this sprint should reduce confusion. Follow-up tickets for trace storage and alerts after that. :thumbsup:
